title: 24 Hours Before Atlantis Sank
title_yt: 24 Hours Before Atlantis Sank: Would You Have Survived?
description:
Around 1600 BC, a rich Bronze Age town on the island of Thera (Santorini) felt the ground shake and saw a thin grey ash fall. Hours later, one of the largest eruptions in human history tore the island apart, and its centre sank into the sea. Many think it is the real disaster behind Plato's legend of Atlantis. Hour by hour, what would you have done, and would you have survived?

{CHAPTERS}

Sources: Plato, Timaeus and Critias; Wikipedia, "Minoan eruption" and "Spyridon Marinatos"; V. Şahoğlu et al., "Volcanic ash, victims, and tsunami debris from the Late Bronze Age Thera eruption discovered at Çeşme-Bağlararası (Turkey)", PNAS 2021; World History Encyclopedia, Akrotiri and Atlantis; Cornell University on the radiocarbon dating of the eruption; National Geographic.

Atlantis is a story told by Plato around 360 BC; most historians think it is fiction, and the link to Thera is a popular theory, not an established fact. The exact date of the eruption is still debated (radiocarbon points to around 1600 BC, some archaeologists prefer a later date), and the hour-by-hour timeline is a reconstruction. The main character and his family are fictional. Visuals and narration are AI-generated, based on historical and scientific accounts.

#History #POV #Atlantis

scenes.text: Twenty-four hours from now, the island you were born on will tear itself apart, and its heart will sink into the sea.
scenes.prompt: aerial view of a green volcanic island in a calm blue sea at dawn, a tall volcanic mountain in the middle, a small ancient stone town on its southern shore, no modern buildings

scenes.text: Remember the wooden bed in your room. Thirty-six centuries from now, strangers will find its shape, hollow, inside the ash.
scenes.prompt: a simple ancient wooden bed frame with woven rope and a wool blanket in a small stone room with a painted plaster wall, soft morning light

scenes.text: This is Akrotiri, a busy harbour town on the island of Thera, in the Aegean Sea. The year is around 1600 BC.
scenes.prompt: aerial view of a small ancient village of flat-roofed grey stone houses on a dry brown hillside above a bay, Bronze Age, no tiled roofs, no modern buildings, morning sun

scenes.text: Some people believe this island is the real story behind the most famous lost city of all. Atlantis.
scenes.prompt: a mysterious ancient island at golden hour seen from the sea, flat-roofed stone houses on a hillside, small wooden boats with oars

scenes.text: Hour by hour, you'll face the choices its people faced. And by the end, you'll know whether you would have survived.
scenes.prompt: over-the-shoulder view of a rugged young Bronze Age Aegean man in his early twenties with stubble and long dark curly hair, tanned, muscular, wearing a short white linen kilt with a red border on a flat stone rooftop looking at a tall volcanic mountain at sunrise

scenes.text: You wake to the sound of gulls and potters' wheels. You're twenty, the son of a family of sea traders.
scenes.prompt: a rugged young Bronze Age Aegean man in his early twenties with stubble and long dark curly hair, tanned, muscular, wearing a short white linen kilt with a red border sitting up in a wooden bed in a small stone room with painted walls, morning light through a small window

scenes.text: Your house has three floors. Stone walls, timber beams, and a flat roof where your family sleeps on hot nights.
scenes.prompt: exterior of an ancient three storey house of rough stone with timber beams and small windows on a narrow paved street, morning sun, Bronze Age Aegean

scenes.text: On the wall of your room, someone painted swallows swooping over red lilies. Every house you know is full of colour.
scenes.prompt: an ancient wall painting on plaster showing swallows flying over red lilies on colourful rocky hills, inside a small stone room, warm light

scenes.text: Under the street runs a stone drain. Some houses here even have a toilet connected to it. For the Bronze Age, that's luxury.
scenes.prompt: a narrow ancient paved stone street between stone houses with a long stone drain channel covered by flat slabs, morning light

scenes.text: Your mother is already in the storeroom, checking the tall clay jars of olive oil, grain and wine.
scenes.prompt: a Bronze Age Aegean woman in her forties with dark hair tied up, wearing a modest long flounced linen dress checking a row of tall painted clay storage jars in a dim stone storeroom

scenes.text: Your little sister is on the roof, watching the harbour. Ships come here from Crete, from the Greek mainland, even from Cyprus.
scenes.prompt: a ten-year-old Bronze Age Aegean girl with long dark braided hair in a simple white linen dress on a flat stone rooftop looking down at a harbour full of ancient wooden ships, blue sea, morning

scenes.text: Crete, home of the great palace of Knossos, lies just over a hundred kilometres south. Your father is there right now, trading.
scenes.prompt: a simple ancient wooden boat with one small square sail and a row of oars, Bronze Age, no rigging sailing on a bright blue sea, dolphins jumping beside it, sunny day

scenes.text: On the hills, women gather saffron from purple crocus flowers. Weighed out in tiny pinches, it's worth a fortune.
scenes.prompt: young women in long linen dresses picking small purple crocus flowers on a rocky sunny hillside, baskets, Bronze Age Aegean

scenes.text: Life here is good. But look closer, and you'll see that your town is broken.
scenes.prompt: a long crack running through the stone wall of an ancient house, a wooden beam propped against it, narrow street, morning light

scenes.text: A few months ago, an earthquake shook the island. Walls split. Staircases collapsed.
scenes.prompt: a collapsed stone staircase inside a damaged ancient stone house, dust in the light

scenes.text: Since then, the whole town has been cleaning up. Rubble is piled in the streets, and broken pots are stacked in corners.
scenes.prompt: piles of stones and broken pottery heaped along a narrow ancient street between stone houses, morning

scenes.text: Archaeologists will later find exactly this: debris cleared out of the houses, and repairs that were never finished.
scenes.prompt: ancient workers in short linen kilts carrying baskets of stones out of a damaged stone house, dusty sunlight

scenes.text: You spend the morning mixing clay and straw to patch the wall of your father's workshop. While he's away, the house is your job.
scenes.prompt: close-up of strong hands mixing wet clay and straw in a wooden trough next to a stone wall, morning sun

scenes.text: Then, at mid-morning, the ground trembles again. Not a big one. Just enough to rattle the jars.
scenes.prompt: tall clay jars on a stone floor shaking, dust falling from wooden ceiling beams, dim storeroom

scenes.text: Dogs start barking all over town. The goats in the pen above the harbour won't stop crying.
scenes.prompt: nervous goats in a dry stone pen on a hillside above an ancient harbour, a barking dog, hazy morning

scenes.text: And on the wind, there's a smell you've never noticed before. Rotten eggs. Sulfur, drifting from the mountain.
scenes.prompt: a rugged young Bronze Age Aegean man in his early twenties with stubble and long dark curly hair, tanned, muscular, wearing a short white linen kilt with a red border covering his nose, looking toward a volcanic mountain with thin white steam rising from its top

scenes.text: Nobody here has ever seen this mountain erupt. Its last great eruption happened thousands of years before anyone was born.
scenes.prompt: a quiet green volcanic mountain above a Bronze Age stone town, thin steam on the summit, blue sky

scenes.text: So most people do what people always do. They tell themselves it will pass.
scenes.prompt: bareheaded ancient Bronze Age men and women in simple linen tunics talking in a small stone square, looking up at a mountain

scenes.text: Just before noon, there's a dull thud from the centre of the island. Then another.
scenes.prompt: a rugged young Bronze Age Aegean man in his early twenties with stubble and long dark curly hair, tanned, muscular, wearing a short white linen kilt with a red border looking up in alarm in a narrow stone street, a flock of birds scattering into the sky

scenes.text: A grey cloud rises above the mountain. A few minutes later, a fine powder starts falling on the town.
scenes.prompt: a thick grey ash cloud rising from the summit of a volcanic mountain, seen from a dry hillside of ancient flat-roofed stone huts, hazy light

scenes.text: It's not much. A thin dusting on the roofs and in your hair. Geologists will find this layer, just a few centimetres thick, under everything else.
scenes.prompt: close-up of fine grey volcanic ash settling on clay pots and a flat stone rooftop

scenes.text: But it's a warning. And now you have a choice.
scenes.prompt: a rugged young Bronze Age Aegean man in his early twenties with stubble and long dark curly hair, tanned, muscular, wearing a short white linen kilt with a red border standing alone in an empty narrow ancient street with grey ash drifting down

scenes.text: Stay and guard the house, the oil, the grain, everything your family owns? Or leave the island now, with only what you can carry?
scenes.prompt: a rugged young Bronze Age Aegean man in his early twenties with stubble and long dark curly hair, tanned, muscular, wearing a short white linen kilt with a red border hesitating in a dim storeroom full of tall clay storage jars, ash drifting through a doorway

scenes.text: Your neighbour decides to stay. Someone has to stop thieves, he says. The mountain has rumbled before.
scenes.prompt: a rugged bearded middle-aged man with stubble in a plain wool tunic standing in a stone doorway with arms folded, ash in the air

scenes.text: Your mother decides for you. She's already wrapping bread, dried fish and a water jar in a blanket.
scenes.prompt: a Bronze Age Aegean woman in her forties with dark hair tied up, wearing a modest long flounced linen dress quickly wrapping round loaves of bread and a small clay water jar in a wool blanket on a wooden table

scenes.text: And here is something remarkable. In the whole town, almost no gold, no jewellery, no valuables will ever be found.
scenes.prompt: an empty open wooden chest on the floor of a small stone room, dust in a beam of light

scenes.text: The people of Akrotiri took their treasures with them. They had time to pack, and they used it.
scenes.prompt: ancient townspeople carrying baskets, bundles and children down a narrow stone street toward the sea, grey ash falling

scenes.text: But the heavy things stay behind. The storage jars. The cooking pots. The furniture. Your bed.
scenes.prompt: a simple ancient wooden bed with a wool blanket in an empty stone room, grey ash drifting through a small window

scenes.text: You take one last look at the swallows on your wall. Then you close the door behind you.
scenes.prompt: a rugged young Bronze Age Aegean man in his early twenties with stubble and long dark curly hair, tanned, muscular, wearing a short white linen kilt with a red border standing in the wooden doorway of a stone house looking back inside, ash falling

scenes.text: Down at the harbour, it's chaos. Families are climbing into anything that floats.
scenes.prompt: crowded ancient harbour with small wooden boats, people with bundles wading and climbing aboard, grey sky

scenes.text: Your family finds space on a cargo ship heading south, toward Crete. Where everyone else went, nobody knows. Not even today.
scenes.prompt: a small ancient wooden rowing boat crowded with people in linen clothes leaving a rocky shore under a grey ash-filled sky

scenes.text: Now leave the ship for a moment, and jump forward about twelve hundred years, to Athens.
scenes.prompt: a classical Greek city with white marble temples on a rocky hill, 4th century BC, warm afternoon light

scenes.text: Around 360 BC, the philosopher Plato is writing two dialogues, called the Timaeus and the Critias.
scenes.prompt: an elderly bearded ancient Greek philosopher in a white robe writing on a papyrus scroll by an oil lamp

scenes.text: In them, he tells a story he says came from Solon, an Athenian statesman who heard it from priests in Egypt.
scenes.prompt: a bearded ancient Greek statesman in a cloak listening to Egyptian priests with shaved heads in white linen, temple courtyard with stone columns

scenes.text: Long ago, the priests said, a mighty island empire called Atlantis ruled from a city ringed by circles of land and water.
scenes.prompt: fantasy painting of a legendary ancient round island city with white temples, surrounded by three circular rings of water and land, aerial view, golden light

scenes.text: Its kings hunted bulls in a sacred grove without weapons, using only clubs and ropes.
scenes.prompt: ancient men holding wooden staffs and ropes surrounding a large black bull in a sacred grove of trees, dramatic light

scenes.text: Then, Plato writes, came violent earthquakes and floods. And in a single terrible day and night, Atlantis sank beneath the sea.
scenes.prompt: a giant dark ocean wave crashing over an ancient city of temples at night, storm

scenes.text: Here's the honest truth: most historians think Atlantis never existed. Plato probably invented it to teach a lesson about pride.
scenes.prompt: an elderly bearded ancient Greek philosopher sitting in thought in a shaded courtyard, scrolls beside him

scenes.text: His details don't fit Thera either. He puts Atlantis in the ocean beyond Gibraltar, nine thousand years before Solon, and bigger than Libya and Asia combined.
scenes.prompt: tall rocky cliffs on both sides of a narrow sea strait opening onto a dark stormy ocean, ancient world, dramatic sky

scenes.text: But some researchers have wondered. A rich island culture. Bull rituals. A sudden catastrophe at sea. Does that sound familiar?
scenes.prompt: an ancient faded wall painting of a young acrobat leaping over a charging bull, cracked plaster

scenes.text: If Plato's story holds any real memory at all, many think it's of what happens next, back on your island.
scenes.prompt: a simple ancient wooden boat with one small square sail and a row of oars, Bronze Age, no rigging at sea, a distant island behind it with a grey plume rising from its mountain

scenes.text: Your ship is a few kilometres offshore when the sound arrives. It hits your chest before your ears understand it.
scenes.prompt: a rugged young Bronze Age Aegean man in his early twenties with stubble and long dark curly hair, tanned, muscular, wearing a short white linen kilt with a red border gripping the wooden rail of an ancient ship in shock, looking back, wind in his hair

scenes.text: Behind you, a column of ash and pumice blasts out of the island, straight up, higher than anything you have ever imagined.
scenes.prompt: a gigantic volcanic eruption column rising from an island into the sky, seen from the sea, tiny wooden ship in the foreground

scenes.text: Scientists estimate it rose thirty to thirty-five kilometres, into the stratosphere. Almost four times higher than Mount Everest.
scenes.prompt: enormous mushroom-shaped volcanic ash plume spreading at the top, seen from far away over the sea, afternoon

scenes.text: This is one of the largest eruptions in human history. Bigger than Vesuvius. Bigger than Krakatoa.
scenes.prompt: a colossal black volcanic ash cloud filling the whole sky above an erupting island, lightning, seen from the sea

scenes.text: The sky turns from blue to brown to black. At one in the afternoon, it's darker than midnight.
scenes.prompt: a simple ancient wooden boat with one small square sail and a row of oars, Bronze Age, no rigging on a dark sea under a black ash-filled sky, a single oil lamp glowing on deck

scenes.text: Then the stones start falling. Pumice, light as bread, grey and white, rattling on the deck like hail.
scenes.prompt: close-up of many small grey pumice stones scattered on old wooden deck planks, falling ash, dim light

scenes.text: Your mother pulls your sister under the blanket. The sailors throw cloaks over their heads and keep rowing.
scenes.prompt: a Bronze Age Aegean woman in her forties with dark hair tied up, wearing a modest long flounced linen dress holding a ten-year-old Bronze Age Aegean girl with long dark braided hair in a simple white linen dress under a wool blanket on the deck of an ancient ship, falling ash

scenes.text: On the island behind you, pumice is burying Akrotiri. In some places, up to seven metres of it will fall.
scenes.prompt: an ancient stone town being buried by falling grey pumice, only rooftops and upper walls visible, dark sky

scenes.text: Your neighbour, the one who stayed? Archaeologists have never found a single body in the town. Maybe he ran in time. Maybe not.
scenes.prompt: an empty stone doorway half-filled with grey pumice stones, dark ash-filled air

scenes.text: The sea around your ship is now covered with floating pumice, so thick the oars push through it like porridge.
scenes.prompt: sea surface completely covered with floating grey pumice stones, wooden oars pushing through, dim light

scenes.text: The captain wants to turn east and shelter at the next island. Your mother begs him to keep going south, to Crete.
scenes.prompt: a rugged young Bronze Age Aegean man in his early twenties with stubble and long dark curly hair, tanned, muscular, wearing a short white linen kilt with a red border and a rugged bearded ship captain with stubble arguing on the deck of an ancient ship, ash falling

scenes.text: On that eastern island, Anafi, ash will pile up three metres deep. The captain listens to your mother.
scenes.prompt: aerial view of a small rocky island being covered in grey volcanic ash under a dark sky

scenes.text: By evening, the eruption changes. Seawater is pouring into the volcano, and wherever it touches magma, it explodes into steam.
scenes.prompt: violent volcanic explosions at sea level throwing up white steam and black ash, orange glow, dusk

scenes.text: Glowing clouds of hot gas and rock roll down the mountain and race out across the water.
scenes.prompt: glowing orange pyroclastic cloud rolling down a volcano and spreading across the sea at night

scenes.text: From the ship, the whole horizon flickers orange. Lightning crackles inside the ash cloud.
scenes.prompt: lightning bolts inside a huge volcanic ash cloud at night, orange glow on the horizon, silhouette of a small wooden ship

scenes.text: No one still on Thera tonight could survive this.
scenes.prompt: distant volcanic island glowing red at night, rivers of fire, seen from far across a dark sea

scenes.text: Then, sometime in the night, the island itself gives way.
scenes.prompt: dark silhouette of a volcanic island cracking and sinking, huge clouds of steam, night

scenes.text: With so much magma blasted out, the ground above the empty chamber collapses. The centre of Thera falls into the sea.
scenes.prompt: aerial view at night of the centre of a volcanic island collapsing into the sea, sea water rushing in, steam

scenes.text: Where a mountain stood this morning, there will be a huge flooded bowl, a caldera, hundreds of metres deep. And when that much rock drops into the sea, the sea pushes back.
scenes.prompt: aerial view of a ring of tall broken cliffs around a huge flooded volcanic crater bay, steam rising, grey dawn

scenes.text: Out in deep water, you barely notice it. The ship rises slowly, then sinks again, like a giant breathing beneath you.
scenes.prompt: a small ancient wooden rowing boat without sails rising on a long smooth ocean swell at night, red glowing sky

scenes.text: That's a tsunami in the open sea. Low, fast, almost invisible. The danger isn't out here. It's on the shore.
scenes.prompt: close-up of a rugged bearded ancient sailor with stubble gripping a thick rope at night, red glow behind him

scenes.text: On the north coast of Crete, the water pulls back first, leaving fish flapping on the sand.
scenes.prompt: an ancient stone coastal town at night, the sea pulled far back, exposed wet seabed with stranded boats

scenes.text: Then it comes. Wave after wave, crashing into harbours and towns.
scenes.prompt: a huge tsunami wave crashing into an ancient stone harbour town at night, foam and spray

scenes.text: At Palaikastro, in eastern Crete, geologists found a layer left by the sea: smashed pottery, building stones and shells, all mixed together.
scenes.prompt: an archaeological trench wall showing a thick layer of broken pottery, stones and sea shells, modern archaeologist with a trowel, daylight

scenes.text: Some researchers estimate the waves there reached around nine metres. More than two storeys high.
scenes.prompt: ruined ancient stone walls on a sunny Mediterranean coast, excavation site, blue sea behind

scenes.text: And the waves didn't stop at Crete. In 2021, archaeologists in western Turkey found, inside tsunami debris, the remains of a young man. And beside him, a dog.
scenes.prompt: archaeologists kneeling in a dusty excavation trench near the sea in Turkey, brushing soil, soft light

scenes.text: They are the first known victims of this eruption ever identified. Caught by the sea, more than two hundred kilometres from the volcano.
scenes.prompt: an excavation trench with layers of sediment and broken pottery, measuring tape, soft evening light

scenes.text: Your captain does the one thing that saves you. He keeps the ship out in deep water all night, far from any harbour.
scenes.prompt: a simple ancient wooden boat with one small square sail and a row of oars, Bronze Age, no rigging alone on a vast dark sea at night, faint red glow on the horizon

scenes.text: You don't sleep. Nobody does. Behind you, the sky over your home glows red until dawn.
scenes.prompt: a rugged young Bronze Age Aegean man in his early twenties with stubble and long dark curly hair, tanned, muscular, wearing a short white linen kilt with a red border sitting at night on the wooden planks of a small boat, a young girl asleep against his shoulder, red glow in the sky

scenes.text: When the sun finally rises, it's a dim brown disc behind the ash.
scenes.prompt: a dim brown sun seen through thick volcanic haze over a grey calm sea, floating pumice

scenes.text: Behind you, your island has changed shape. Its heart is gone, replaced by a bay of black water and steam.
scenes.prompt: distant volcanic island with tall broken cliffs and a steaming bay in the middle, grey morning haze

scenes.text: Ahead are the mountains of Crete. Your father's ship might be waiting there. Or it might not.
scenes.prompt: a simple ancient wooden boat with one small square sail and a row of oars, Bronze Age, no rigging approaching a mountainous coastline in grey hazy morning light

scenes.text: The eruption did not wipe out Minoan Crete overnight, as people once believed. Most experts now think the Minoans recovered and kept building for generations.
scenes.prompt: a Bronze Age palace courtyard with red tapered wooden columns and stone stairs in bright sunlight, people in linen clothes

scenes.text: But Akrotiri was never rebuilt. Your town would stay hidden under the pumice for more than thirty-five centuries.
scenes.prompt: a barren landscape of white and grey pumice cliffs above the sea, empty, quiet morning

scenes.text: In the 1860s, workers dug volcanic ash on the island to make cement for the Suez Canal. Here and there, they hit ancient walls.
scenes.prompt: 19th century workers with pickaxes in a quarry of white volcanic ash cliffs, sepia photograph look

scenes.text: But the real excavation began in 1967, led by the Greek archaeologist Spyridon Marinatos.
scenes.prompt: a rugged 1960s Greek archaeologist man in his sixties with a hat and short white beard standing at an excavation, black and white photograph

scenes.text: Back in 1939, Marinatos had argued that this eruption struck Minoan Crete. Many experts weren't convinced.
scenes.prompt: a 1930s male scholar with a moustache in a suit writing at a desk covered with papers and old photographs, lamp light, sepia

scenes.text: Under the pumice, his team found streets, squares and houses still standing two and three storeys high, with their stairs in place.
scenes.prompt: excavated ancient stone town with two storey houses and stone stairs, under a large modern protective roof, archaeologists

scenes.text: They found the storage jars, the cooking pots, and the wall paintings. Even the swallows.
scenes.prompt: excavated stone room with large ancient clay storage jars still standing in place, soft light

scenes.text: Where wooden furniture had rotted away, they found holes in the ash. They poured in plaster, and got back the shape of a bed.
scenes.prompt: a white plaster cast of a simple ancient bed in an excavated stone room, archaeologist's brush beside it

scenes.text: But no bodies. And almost no gold. Only one tiny golden figure of a wild goat.
scenes.prompt: small golden figurine of a wild goat with long curved horns on a dark museum stand, spotlight

scenes.text: Marinatos died at the site in 1974, after a fall during the excavation. He was buried there, beside the streets he uncovered.
scenes.prompt: quiet ancient excavation site at sunset, stone walls and a simple grave with flowers

scenes.text: Even the date is still argued over. Radiocarbon points to around 1600 BC. Some archaeologists, using Egyptian records, argue for decades later.
scenes.prompt: a charred ancient olive branch on a laboratory table next to a microscope, soft light

scenes.text: So, would you have survived?
scenes.prompt: a rugged young Bronze Age Aegean man in his early twenties with stubble and long dark curly hair, tanned, muscular, wearing a short white linen kilt with a red border standing on the deck of an ancient ship looking ahead at a coastline, soft morning light

scenes.text: If you stayed to guard your house, almost certainly not.
scenes.prompt: an empty stone doorway half-buried in grey pumice, silent, grey light

scenes.text: But if you listened to the shaking ground, the sulfur and that first thin ash, and you left, you had a real chance. Most of Akrotiri seems to have done exactly that.
scenes.prompt: small ancient wooden boats full of people rowing away from an island at sunrise, calm sea

scenes.text: Where they went, we still don't know. Their story ends at the harbour.
scenes.prompt: an empty ancient stone harbour at dusk, calm water, a single wooden boat pulled up on the beach

scenes.text: In 2025, thousands of earthquakes shook Santorini again, and thousands of people left by ferry and plane. The island had not forgotten.
scenes.prompt: a modern passenger ferry leaving a harbour below tall dark volcanic cliffs at dusk

scenes.text: Remember that bed? It stayed behind. Its owner took the one thing that really mattered. Their life.
scenes.prompt: a white plaster cast of a simple ancient bed in a quiet excavated room, warm beam of light

scenes.text: Atlantis may only ever have lived in Plato's mind. But an island that sank in a day and a night was real.
scenes.prompt: aerial view of a huge flooded volcanic caldera ringed by tall cliffs at sunset, calm sea

scenes.text: Would you have stayed, or run for the boats? Tell me in the comments.
scenes.prompt: back view of a rugged bearded young man with broad shoulders and long dark curly hair standing in a small wooden boat, looking at a distant smoking island at sunrise

blocks.text: or leave everything behind?
You live on a Bronze Age island. Months ago, an earthquake cracked your town.
Today the ground shakes again. The air smells of sulfur. Then a fine grey ash starts falling.
Your neighbour stays to guard his house. Your mother packs bread and water.
Hours later, the mountain explodes, and pumice buries the town metres deep.
Archaeologists never found a single body there. Most people ran. So what would you do? Stay with your home,
